name: d1_batchlane
description: SoA 8-lane zmm batch-lane engine: interleaved-pair m=1 kernels at 13/31 (d1_prime), in-register AoS codelets at 32/64 (d1_pow2), broadcast-fed PFA ymm1/zmm2x2 kernels at 60 (d1_composite), register-resident B=1 chains (fold-ready A/B rows at 13/31, natural-row four-step at 32/64/128), L1-blocked fused FFT+Newton-map batched chain
